reason: Bending the metal stock seems like a natural first step toward a frame for the place to sit and work.
expectation: I expect to make a frame or structural parts, though I don't know exactly what shape they will take.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric could make padding, but I want to establish the structure first.

effect: The brake produced frame sections, giving me structural parts to build on.
reaction: That was the expected result, so nothing particularly surprising.
reason: The paving blocks may form a solid surface or support when combined with the frame sections.
expectation: I expect a partial piece of furniture, though I don't know whether it will be a seat or a work surface.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric could provide padding, but I want to see how the structure comes together first.

effect: The frame and blocks made a bench with ceramic feet, establishing both a seat and a worktop.
reaction: Using the blocks as feet was a satisfying connection to the earlier floor-making work.
reason: Combining the felt and fabric is the only numbered action offered and may make padding for the bare bench.
expectation: I expect some kind of cushion or upholstered covering, though its exact form is uncertain.

effect: The felt and fabric made the expected cushion, ready to add to the bench.
reaction: The result was straightforward and reassuring.
reason: Adding the cushion to the bare bench is the only numbered action offered and should make the seat usable.
expectation: I expect a finished, more comfortable window bench, though I don't know whether that will complete the goal.

effect: The cushion completed the window bench and the chapter’s goal, providing both a seat and a worktop beneath the window.
reaction: The image of watching the sunset from the padded bench made the finished object feel personal.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the frame with ceramic blocks was most worthwhile: the blocks became feet, connecting the bench to the earlier floor-making work.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making and adding the cushion were straightforward, with only one numbered action offered at each step. They were reassuring but involved little decision-making.

surprise.text: I was unsure how the ceramic blocks would be used, so seeing them become bench feet clarified the construction.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the parts had understandable roles, though the blocks’ purpose was uncertain before combining them.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the expedition unfolds. The finished bench gave a small glimpse of daily life on Mars, although this chapter offered few meaningful choices.
